heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy north; mostly to partly cloudy south. Showers becoming likely from the northern Greens westward, mainly late; chance northeast. Highs from the mid 40s to around 50, except low to mid 50s in southeastern valleys. Southwest winds 5 to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy in southern valleys; otherwise mostly cloudy. Scattered showers from the Adirondacks and Route 2 northward; chance south to Route 4; all tapering off after midnight. Lows from the mid 30s to around 40, some lower 30s over high terrain north. Winds becoming west 10 to 15 mph, and gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy far north in the morning; otherwise partly cloudy, before clouds increase in the afternoon. Chance of a rain or snow shower in the mountains, mainly northeast. Highs in the mid to upper 40s, except low to mid 50s in southeastern valleys and in the Hudson Valley. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Greens.
